description: List current arbitrage: two prices at two different bookmakers that cover one market, so a stake split between them returns a profit whichever side wins. By default only arbs where every bet is at an Australian bookmaker are shown; set region to all for every bookmaker. Each arb shows the event, market, each bookmaker's price and the time SockOdds saw it, and how to split the stake. Needs a Pro key or the free 7-day Pro trial. Costs 10 credits for each page of up to 100 arbs it reads (at most 3 pages); the bookmaker list it reads first is free.

league_id.description: Only this league, for example nba, nfl, afl or nrl. Leave it out for every league.

min_profit_pct.description: Only arbs paying at least this percent of the total stake, for example 1

region.description: Keep arbs whose every bet is at a bookmaker in this region. Default au (Australian bookmakers). Use all for every bookmaker.

stake.description: Total stake to split across the bets, in dollars. Default 100.

name: find_arbs
title: Find arbitrage
